FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.NativeText: Native Text: draw a text box, then enter its text in Foundry's configuration
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.Tool: Path tool: click waypoints; double-click or Enter to finish
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.Title: Paths
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.PartialCopy: Partial or changed paths were copied as ordinary artwork, without editability. Select a complete intact path to keep its recipe.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.PortableLoss: These paths are included as ordinary native artwork only. Their recipes and memberships are omitted; imported artwork will not be reopenable as paths.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.DimensionReference: This path uses a {reference} px dimensional reference (Scene grid: {scene} px). Width currently resolves to {width} px. Import preserves scene-pixel dimensions; scaling a stamp scales this reference, width, meander and sleeper/bend spacing together.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.ConflictHint: "{name}" no longer matches its saved path. No regeneration or overwrite has occurred. Cancel to keep reviewing, or detach its remaining artwork.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.ConflictDetachHint: Detach removes the recipe and only memberships still belonging to this path. Current artwork, external edits and missing components are left as they are. This conflict resolution clears Scene Path history and cannot be undone through Path Undo.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.DeleteConfirm: Delete every component of "{name}" and its retained recipe? Use Path Undo to restore this operation during this session.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.DetachConfirm: Detach "{name}"? Artwork stays unchanged, but the retained recipe and memberships are removed. The Drawings become ordinary artwork. Use Path Undo to restore editability during this session.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.HistoryEmpty: There is no path operation to undo or redo.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.HistoryConflict: Path history conflicts with changed artwork or metadata. No changes were applied; review the Scene before retrying.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.HistoryLimit: This path operation exceeds the 24 MiB session history budget. Finish a smaller section.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.NativeUndo: Native Drawing undo cannot restore a retained path recipe. Use Path Undo/Redo in the toolbox instead.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.HistoryHelp: Path Undo/Redo restores retained metadata and all affected components together, independently of native Ctrl+Z. History is local to this GM, Scene and browser session (20 operations / 24 MiB); reload clears it. Unrelated artwork is not restored. Conflicting edits, locked/hidden destinations or pending recovery refuse replay. New path operations discard redo. Recovery, conflict detach and project/stamp imports involving retained paths clear Scene path history. Cancel an active draft before using history or whole-path actions.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.SelectOnePath: Select components from one retained path only.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.EditorChanged: The path, Scene, Level or editing permission changed. Reopen the path to review it again.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.EditorLocked: Show and unlock the path's layer and component Drawings before editing.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.EditorDamaged: This retained path has missing or externally changed components. Editing is refused to protect the artwork.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.EditorApplied: Path waypoint changes were applied and verified.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.EditorHelp: Drag a waypoint or enter scene-pixel X/Y. Choose Smooth for linked tangent directions or Corner for independent handles; drag the selected point's white handles or edit their coordinates. Automatic resets calculated tangents. Move whole path translates points and handles together. Draft Undo/Redo (20 changes) groups each drag as one change; Ctrl/Cmd+Z and Shift+Z or Ctrl/Cmd+Y work outside text inputs. Apply saves; Cancel leaves artwork unchanged. Enter applies, Escape cancels, Delete removes a point. Pen editing needs no modifier.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.AppearanceHelp: These settings belong to the path, not the current brush. Width is in grid squares (0.03 gives 3 px on a 100 px grid); native strokes have a 1 px minimum. Color changes the line, rails, or road/river surface; mapping edges and details retain their accent colors. Closed loops require three points; automatic curves and meander join at the seam. Closed railway sleepers are evenly distributed around the loop, with no duplicate at the seam. Manual handles override automatic curve settings. New variation changes only the seed; presets copy settings and closure, never points, handles or the seed.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.alphaHint: Opacity of every generated component. 0 is fully transparent.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.ThreePoints: Add at least three different waypoints for a closed loop.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.PresetSave: Save path settings as a preset
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.PresetInvalid: Path presets are invalid. Names must contain 1-60 characters and all settings must be valid.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.PresetFull: The path preset library is full (32 presets).
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.PresetChanged: The path preset changed or no longer exists.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.PresetDeleteConfirm: Delete the path preset "{name}"? Saved paths will not change.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.InsertHelp: Click between waypoints on the preview. Without meander, insertion subdivides the curve without changing its shape and freezes automatic tangents as Corner handles. With meander, insertion adds a new fixed anchor and recalculates the variation; its shape can change.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.PendingOperation: A path save or recovery is unfinished. Resolve it before editing, copying, importing or publishing this Scene's artwork.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.InvalidRecovery: The path recovery record is invalid. Artwork is suppressed until the record is inspected and repaired.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.RecoveryHint: Restore the Scene's artwork and path definitions to their exact state before the unfinished path operation. New components from that operation will be removed. Recovery refuses external edits and never regenerates a path automatically. If it cannot complete, the recovery record stays in place.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.RecoverySuccess: The unfinished path operation was recovered and verified.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.smoothingHint: 1 gives a smooth curve through every waypoint; lower values tighten the bends. 0 uses straight segments.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.meanderHint: Maximum sideways variation in grid squares. 0 disables meandering. Applies to plain lines, rails, roads and rivers; clicked waypoints stay fixed. Each new path gets a stable variation pattern.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.bendSpacingHint: Distance between variations along the route. Smaller values create frequent bends; larger values create broad, gentle meanders.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.widthHint: Plain/road/river width, or railway rail separation, in Scene grid squares.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.spacingHint: Distance between railway sleepers along the entire path, including across corners.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.Help: Choose a visible, unlocked active layer. Click waypoints; double-click or Enter finishes. Backspace removes the last point; Escape cancels. Choose smooth or straight segments, optional meander and a width in grid squares. Closed loops need three distinct points; do not repeat the first point. Plain lines and rails initially use the brush appearance unless a path color, opacity or preset was explicitly chosen. Roads and rivers use path settings. Finished paths retain their waypoints and generate native component Drawings. Select any component and choose Edit path, or open Saved paths here. Use Path Undo/Redo for complete saved operations, not native Ctrl+Z; detach before editing components individually.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.Points: {count} waypoints. Click to add; Enter or double-click to finish.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.Pending: Wait for the current path to finish saving.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.NoLayer: Choose a visible, unlocked active drawing layer before drawing a path.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.Changed: The path destination changed. Start the path again.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.TwoPoints: Add at least two different waypoints before finishing.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.Limit: Too many waypoints. Finish a shorter path section.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.Incomplete: Not all path components were created. Inspect the layer before retrying.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Paths.Created: Path created on the active layer.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.LevelExportHint: Active-Level export includes only Drawings associated with that Level. Full export includes all Levels. Drawing layers/groups and presentation metadata are retained; hidden artwork is not redacted.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.LevelImportHint: Choose one source Level to import onto the active destination Level, or explicitly combine the full project. Source IDs are local references; no automatic ID/name matching or destination Level creation occurs.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.CombineLevels: Combine full project onto active Level
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.CombineLevelsWarning: Combine changes all imported Drawings to the active Level's ground elevation. Drawing-layer/group order is retained; within each layer, new sorts follow original elevation then native sort, with stable package-order ties. Cross-floor overlaps become a new composition, not pixel-identical artwork. Existing artwork and Level settings are never reordered or changed.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.LevelImportCounts: Included Drawings: {included}; excluded from other Levels: {excluded}. Imported elevation: {ground}.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.RestoreInvalid: Choose a completed apply matching this command's destination with no existing restore intent, and resolve unfinished operations first. Tile/background Bake requires the latest apply; Consolidate can expand an earlier restored composite's retained lineage.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.RestoreConflict: Every archived original must be absent and the exact baked replacement must still be unchanged before creating a restore intent.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.RestoreIntentCancelled: Restore intent creation was cancelled. No restore journal entry or native changes were made.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.RestoreIntentSummary: Create a restore intent for operation {token}; this will reintroduce {count} exact archived Drawings after verification.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.RestoreIntentWarning: This writes a durable restore journal intent, not native documents. The subsequent preview, placement and native execution require separate approvals. Existing later Drawings are preserved. Conflicts refuse; nothing is overwritten.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.RestoreLayerRevision: Layer revision advanced from {archived} to {current}, but every other archived layer-tree value matches. Restore retains the current revision; further context changes invalidate this approval.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.TakeoverUnavailable: Only the designated active GM may take over an unfinished Tile Bake, and only after its recorded owner is disconnected.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.TakeoverEvidenceFailed: The exact retained archive/output and native recovery state could not be freshly verified. Ownership was not transferred.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.TakeoverStale: The operation changed during takeover review. No takeover is permitted; inspect the current journal.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.TakeoverSummary: Take over {action} operation {token} at phase {phase} from disconnected GM {owner}. This covers {count} archived Drawings.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.TakeoverWarning: This transfers only the journal owner after verifying retained files and current native state. It does not create a cross-client lock or server compare-and-swap. The previous owner must be disconnected; all preview, placement and execution reviews still apply, and native recovery remains conflict-sensitive.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.TakeoverCancelled: Recovery ownership transfer was cancelled before any journal change.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.ResumeInvalid: Choose the final unfinished Bake apply/restore operation matching this command's destination. Completed operations need a separate restore intent; missing files need exact-byte asset recovery before execution.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.ResumeStale: The Scene, artwork, workspace or journal changed during reload recovery review. Inspect this operation again before resuming.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.ResumeDisplayFailed: Native display was not accepted. The operation remains recoverable; no further apply step is permitted.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.ResumeComplete: Bake recovery {token} ({action}) completed. Retain the immutable recovery files.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.OptionsHint: Choose the displayed-Level artwork and output options. This dialog makes no writes. Exact exclusions, crop, preview, durable files and apply are reviewed separately.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.ScopeAll: All eligible Drawings on this Level
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.SortHint: Enter an explicit integer stack order among native Tiles at ground elevation. No sort is guessed. Ink moves below remaining Drawings and Tokens.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.Quality: Encoding quality (WEBP; PNG retains this review value)
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.CropHint: Custom Tile origins and dimensions must be integers; width/height must be positive. Automatic bounds are measured during rendering. No silent movement or downsampling.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.ExternalConsent: Allow contacting external texture URLs for this preparation. Remote servers may observe the request; credentials are omitted. This does not bypass resource or capability checks.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.OptionsInvalid: Choose a valid scope/layer or nonempty selection, explicit audience and integer Tile sort, PNG/WEBP encoding, quality from 0 to 1, and valid integer custom bounds when selected.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.OptionsStale: Artwork, selection, layers, workspace, Level or journal changed while choosing Bake options. Review again.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.EntryBusy: A Bake review is already open for this Scene. Finish or close it before starting another.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.EntryTokenUsed: This Bake operation token is already journaled. Use recovery/resume review instead of starting a new operation with it.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.EntryDialogsInvalid: The Bake entry point requires every scope, render, placement, preview, persistence and execution review callback.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.EntryComplete: Bake {token} completed. Keep its output and recovery files for restoration.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.EntryCancelledBeforeWri: Bake cancelled before durable writes. Original artwork is unchanged.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.EntryCancelledRetained: Bake {token} cancelled at phase {phase}. Durable recovery files and journal are retained; inspect/resume this operation before starting another. Cancellation does not roll back or delete recovery evidence.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.BackgroundOptionsInvali: Background Bake requires explicit player audience and a reviewed scope. Custom bounds, Tile identities and Tile sort are not applicable.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.ConsolidationOptionsInv: Consolidate requires explicit audience and Selected Drawings or one leaf layer. Bounds and sort are retained automatically; All and groups are not supported.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.ConsolidationWarning: Consolidate replaces one contiguous Drawing run with an editable image Drawing in the same layer, elevation and native stack position. Individual strokes require Restore originals. New artwork remains independent. Originals are removed only after verified durable recovery and separate apply approval. Layer player visibility is retained.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.ConsolidationStackWarni: Consolidate retains Drawing stack depth, not ground placement. Intervening artwork, mixed layers/elevations and ambiguous sort ties refuse instead of silently changing order.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.ConsolidationComplete: Consolidate {token} completed. Keep its output and recovery files; individual strokes require Restore originals.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.BackgroundOriginalChang: The original background URL no longer contains the archived bytes. Restore the original file from its retained immutable backup before restoring this Bake. No replacement will be reverted to changed image bytes.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.BackgroundWarning: This replaces the Level's existing background with a full-Scene image combining that background and the chosen ink. Ink moves below Tiles as well as Drawings and Tokens. The original image bytes and settings must be retained for recovery. Only public artwork and identity shared texture transforms are supported.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.FolderHint: Choose an existing shared Foundry data folder for immutable Bake outputs and original recovery archives. Create it manually before use. Never use module/system folders or disposable cache storage. Changing this setting affects new operations only; retained journals keep their original paths. No files are moved or deleted automatically.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.StorageChanged: Bake storage requires the designated active GM, file browse/upload permissions and an unchanged folder/review context.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.StorageListingInvalid: The Bake storage folder could not be verified exactly. The data-folder listing is invalid or points to a different directory.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.StoragePrivate: Bake outputs require a shared data folder. Choose a folder that is not marked private in the FilePicker; hidden artwork is not secure secret storage.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.Cancelled: Bake review cancelled. No further operation was approved.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.Changed: Bake review requires the designated active GM and an unchanged Scene, Level and review context.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.Acknowledge: I have reviewed these exact values and warnings.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryExport.Title: Review portable recovery ZIP
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.Cancelled: Recovery import review cancelled. No operation was approved.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.Changed: Recovery review requires the designated active GM and an unchanged current context.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.InvalidAction: This recovery review action is not supported.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.InvalidDecisi: The exact recovery visibility decisions are invalid.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.Level:
Exact Level before: {before}
Exact Level target: {after}
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.ImportTitle: Approve exact recovery import and uploads
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.StorageRoot: Existing shared data folder (for example worlds/my-world/assets)
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.ActionSummary: Import {token}; phase {phase}; evidence state {state}. Missing files: {missing}. Only exact verified actions are offered. Each write requires separate approval; this selection never retries uploads or compensates automatically.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.ActionEvidenc: A retained import journal, exact receipt or stored receipt reference is required.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.ActionReviewC: This action review was already used. Inspect again before another write decision.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.Action-retire: Retain receipt, then review compensated journal clearing
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.Action-retain: Verify or separately review durable receipt storage
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.SetupWarning: Destination: {scene} ({id}). Choose one Level and a recovery ZIP up to {maxBytes} bytes. Only an empty Drawing/Tile project is supported. This does not create or activate a Scene. Use an existing shared data folder, never module/system/cache storage. Setup grants no upload or native-write authority; exact-plan, hidden staging and final release reviews follow.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.SetupBudgets: Explicit valid file, entry, receipt and timeout budgets are required before recovery setup.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.SetupDestinat: An exact destination Scene Level is required.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.InvalidZipFil: Choose exactly one nonempty .zip file within the reviewed byte limit. ZIP contents will be strictly validated before import approval.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.SetupListing: The storage file inventory is invalid.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.ImportDecisio: Approve this exact destination-bound import, durable intent and verified file uploads.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.MetadataDecis: Replace the destination's empty-project layer and preset metadata.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.ImportWarning: Import only into this empty Drawing/Tile project. Preserve source coordinates and numeric elevation; rebind destination Level identity and Scene context without resampling image bytes. Historical GM-private artwork may be included. Fonts/modules are not embedded and must remain available. Persist intent before uploads; retain every file. Hidden staging and final native release require later separate approval, including renewed Tile/background visibility consent. No automatic retry or rollback.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.UploadSummary: {count} retained evidence/asset files; {bytes} total upload bytes.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.ReceiptFile: Receipt file: {bytes} bytes. Exact SHA-256 fingerprint: {fingerprint}
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.ReceiptWarnin: Write and verify only this immutable receipt JSON file. Keep all server evidence files. The receipt may contain historical GM-private artwork metadata; treat it as GM-private. This does not clear the Scene journal, resume, retry an import or transfer ownership. If upload acknowledgement is uncertain, retain the exact file reference and inspect it; do not automatically retry.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.ReceiptDecisi: Store and verify this exact receipt file without clearing the journal.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.StageWarning: Install only hidden owned artwork and the closed Drawing tree. This does not install optimization history, replace the background or approve native visibility.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.CompensateWar: Delete only the listed exact hidden staged artwork and restore prior layer metadata. Leave the Level/background untouched. Retain all files and the compensated journal; this does not clear the import block or authorize retry.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.FinalizeWarni: Install complete recovery history and release exact imported native sources. The Drawing wrapper remains closed. Tiles and backgrounds do not obey that wrapper and may immediately be visible to players. Imported Restore returns source historical backgrounds, not the destination baseline. Clear intent only after verification. Retain all files; uncertain release is not automatically retried or rolled back.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.ResumeWarning: Finish only remaining exact release steps after fresh evidence inspection. Already-final artwork, history and backgrounds are not rewritten. The Drawing wrapper stays closed; Tiles/backgrounds may already be player-visible and remaining release requires renewed visibility approval. Imported Restore returns source historical backgrounds, not the destination baseline. Keep all files. No automatic retry, rollback or owner takeover.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.ClearWarning: Remove only the verified compensated import journal. Keep its receipt and every server file. No artwork, layer, Level or history changes are approved. A new import needs fresh preparation, identities, collision checks and approval. This dialog does not save the receipt or authorize retry; the caller must retain the receipt before execution.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.StageDecision: Approve these exact hidden staging sources.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.DeleteDecisio: Delete only these exact hidden staging sources.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.RetainDecisio: Retain the receipt and every server recovery file.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.FinalizeDecis: Install the exact history and finalize this import.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.ResumeDecisio: Resume only the exact remaining release steps.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.TileDecision: Approve native Tile visibility independently of the closed Drawing wrapper.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.BackgroundDec: Approve Level background replacement and visibility independently of the Drawing wrapper.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryImport.ClearDecision: Clear only this exact compensated receipt journal after retaining the receipt.
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryExport.Download: Download ZIP and retain server files
FOUNDRYSHOP.RecoveryExport.Disclosure: Download the exact verified ZIP containing this Level's artwork images and complete recovery ancestry. Historical GM-private artwork may be included: treat this file as GM-private, not a player presentation. Fonts and modules are not embedded. Keep all server recovery files. Starting a browser download does not prove disk completion. This does not import, upload, modify the Scene or authorize artwork exposure.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.RestorePlacementWarning: Restore removes the retained baked replacement and recreates exact archived originals with their native hidden values and Drawing presentation gates. This is not a new public Bake or ground-flattening approval. Imported background Restore returns source historical settings, not the destination pre-import background.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.GroundWarning: Bake moves ink to ground artwork below remaining Drawings and Tokens. The original Drawings will be removed only after verified durable recovery and separate apply approval.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.HiddenWarning: GM-hidden artwork is presentation-only, not secure secret storage.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.Memory: Output RGBA buffer: {bytes} bytes. This is advisory, not peak memory; encoding and GPU allocations need additional memory.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.RenderWarning: Bounds are conservative geometry/text extents, not occupied pixels. Cropped artwork may lose ink in the output. Best-effort rendering is not a guarantee of native pixel equivalence. Fixed-resolution raster artwork can sample edges and text differently when zoomed or positioned on fractional pixels. No silent downsampling is performed.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.OverlapWarning: Overlap estimates are conservative bounds, not pixel-exact occlusion. Baking changes stack depth.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.ApplyWarning: This approval permits native writes for this exact operation. Apply removes only the archived originals; restore reintroduces those originals and reverts the replacement. Interrupted writes retain recovery records and require inspection before resuming.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.Paths: Exact persistent recovery and output paths
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.PersistWarning: This approval permits journal and file writes, not native apply. These files are durable recovery, not temporary cache. Do not delete them. Lost acknowledgements may leave written files or an unfinished journal even if the operation reports an error.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.InvalidPreview: Bake preview requires nonempty PNG or WEBP output.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.PreviewSize: Full output: {width} x {height} pixels. The image is scaled only for this dialog.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Bake.PreviewWarning: Accepting this preview does not upload files, change native documents or remove Drawings. File persistence and native apply require separate approvals.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Pairs.Invalid: The paired appearance is invalid. Use colors, an interior mode and optional material/scale only.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Pairs.LocalOnly: Choose a shipped material or a local Foundry image path.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Pairs.Unavailable: Paired appearance requires GM access, a ready Scene and Drawing creation mode.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Pairs.Changed: The brush, palette, layer, Scene or permissions changed. Choose the paired appearance again.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Pairs.Title: {name} — Line: {line}; Interior: {fill}, {mode}; Material: {texture}; Repeat: {repeat} squares. Paired swatch.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Pairs.Name: Name
FOUNDRYSHOP.Pairs.Inherited: Preview uses current line width {width}px, line opacity {line}% and interior opacity {fill}%. These values are not saved in the pair.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Tablet.Title: Wacom Intuos4 PTK-840
FOUNDRYSHOP.Tablet.BindingHint: Assign a shortcut in Configure Controls, then enter the same keystroke for an ExpressKey in Wacom Tablet Properties. Tool switching is blocked while drawing or dragging.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Tablet.Setup: Assign two ExpressKeys: Freehand pencil and Tokens: Select / Move. First bind these actions in Configure Controls; then create a profile for Chrome or Edge in Wacom Tablet Properties and assign the matching keystrokes. Name the buttons after their actions. No keys are assigned automatically.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Tablet.BrowserHint: Wacom profiles apply to the browser application, not just the Foundry tab. Consider using a dedicated browser for Foundry. Avoid browser/Windows shortcuts that never reach Foundry. This panel cannot program the driver or tablet displays; pen pressure is not implemented.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Tablet.TestPlaceholder: Click here, then press an ExpressKey
FOUNDRYSHOP.Tablet.TestHint: The test only receives keys while this field is focused. It does not execute actions or save input. Tab leaves the field; Escape ends capture. Browser-reserved shortcuts may still act outside Foundry.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Tablet.TestReady: Listening in this field only. Press an ExpressKey; Tab or Escape ends the test.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Tablet.Unavailable: This tool shortcut requires a ready Scene, GM access and an available tool. Freehand also requires Drawing creation permission.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Tablet.Gesture: Finish the current canvas press, drag or placement write before switching tools.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Tablet.Busy: A tool switch is already in progress. Wait before trying again.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Tablet.Changed: The Scene, authority or selected tool changed during activation. Check the current tool before continuing.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Materials.ApplyHint: Explicitly replace the selected drawings' fill type, texture, tint, opacity and repeat width. Strokes, geometry and labels stay unchanged. Fitted image stamps cannot be changed here.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Materials.ApplyConfirm: Replace the fill settings on {count} selected drawings with the current brush fill? This changes existing artwork, not just future drawing defaults. Strokes, geometry and labels are preserved.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Materials.SelectArtwork: Select at least one Drawing to apply fill settings.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Materials.SelectionLocked: All selected drawings must be editable, unlocked and outside locked layers or pending imports. No fill settings were applied.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Materials.ImageStamp: Fitted image stamps cannot receive repeating material fills. Deselect them and try again.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Materials.MissingTexture: Choose a texture before applying a Pattern fill.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Materials.SelectionChanged: The selection, artwork, Scene, Level, grid or brush defaults changed. Review them and apply again.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Materials.ApplyFailed: The fill update was not saved exactly as requested. Some drawings may have changed; inspect the selection before retrying.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Materials.Unknown: This material is no longer available.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Materials.StarterHint: Original seamless grayscale materials, ready for tinting. Previews show the untinted source. Repeat size controls the width of one texture tile on new drawings.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Materials.RepeatHint: Width of one texture tile, 0.05-100 grid squares (100 pixels per square on gridless Scenes). Keeps the image aspect ratio. Saved textured prefabs scale their texture with the artwork. Existing drawings are unchanged.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Materials.Clear: Clear texture and use solid fill
FOUNDRYSHOP.Materials.Hint: Pattern repeats a texture inside new shapes. Fill color tints it; white preserves its colors. Fill opacity controls transparency. Choose a local static PNG/JPEG/WEBP; existing artwork is unchanged.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Materials.LocalOnly: Choose an existing same-server texture file. External URLs and temporary image paths are not supported by this material picker.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Materials.Unavailable: Material selection requires an active GM Drawing toolbox.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Materials.Changed: The Scene, Level or brush defaults changed while checking the material. Select it again.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Palettes.ResetConfirm: Reset this built-in palette's name and colors to the shipped defaults? Custom edits to this palette will be removed. Other palettes and placed artwork will not change.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Palettes.UnifiedHint: Single colors change the active Line/Interior target; split swatches change both. Use + for a color or the split-circle button for a pair. Manage or right-click to edit. Changes are shared with GMs; built-ins can be reset. Saved prefab styles stay unchanged.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Builtins.Hint: Original editable prefabs in the Fantasy Mapping palette. Place uses the active layer and displayed Level. Size follows the Scene grid (100px on gridless Scenes); rotation, scale and Repeat use the stamp controls above. These are visual Drawings, not Walls, doors or lights.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.Title: Project library
FOUNDRYSHOP.Examples.Title: Example projects
FOUNDRYSHOP.Examples.Hint: Complete editable maps with nested layers, textures, labels and three presentation presets. Previews include all artwork, including presentation-hidden notes. Import opens the normal review: choose empty/additive mode and pixel offsets; nothing is placed until confirmed. Imported groups start player-hidden. No background, grid, Walls or lighting changes.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Examples.Description.wayfare: A woodland tavern with flagstone floor, planked tables, supplies and styled room labels.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Examples.Description.woodlan: A forest shrine with brick dais, stone columns, rippling pond and landscape labels.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.FolderInvalid: Configure a project library data folder using simple relative path segments, without traversal or modules/systems roots.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.FolderHint: GM-configured existing folder in Foundry's data source. Browse immediate project/shape JSON files; save the current project or selected artwork as fresh files. No recursive scan or automatic overwrite.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.Scope: Shared project and reusable shape files. Saving creates a new file, not a Scene edit. Shapes place through the stamp preview; projects use confirmed import. Texture paths are references, not embedded image files. Thumbnails may show hidden artwork.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.Title: Export artwork WEBP
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.SVGHint: Vector-only export from the displayed Level. Choose an explicit audience and whole-map or layer/group scope, as with WEBP. Rectangle/ellipse/path geometry, native smoothing curves, names, rotation and opacity are preserved. No raster images, textures, Level backgrounds or Scene UI. JSON remains the exact editable-project backup; SVG is export-only.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.SVGLimits: Uses the same bounded Drawing snapshot and output dimensions as WEBP: 1,000 Drawings, 100,000 coordinates, 4 MiB snapshot, one elevation/render mode; 8,192px axes, 16 million output pixels and 32 MiB encoded bytes. Unsupported textured/image-stamp artwork blocks the entire export with named diagnostics, never silently disappears.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.SVGFidelity: I accept SVG fidelity limits: fonts are not embedded and must be installed in the viewer; wrapping uses current native font metrics, but text baselines, outlines/shadows and antialiasing can differ between viewers. Complex/self-intersecting filled paths may differ from native triangulation. Joins/caps are miter/butt (miter limit 10), fill rule is nonzero, and opacity is separate for fill/stroke/text. Layer/group names repeat when required to preserve interleaved native stack order. No native metadata, locks, presets or recovery data.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.SVGConsent: I understand and accept these SVG fidelity limits.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.SVGDescription: Foundryshop vector-only publication. Fonts remain external; text effects, complex filled paths and antialiasing can vary by viewer. JSON is the authoritative editable-project backup.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.SVGRaster: Raster texture or image stamp is unsupported in strict vector SVG. Use WEBP or choose a vector-only scope.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.SVGDegenerate: Degenerate rectangle/ellipse geometry (stroke at least as large as its dimensions) cannot preserve native stroke rendering in SVG. Use WEBP or adjust its dimensions/stroke.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.SVGBlocked: SVG export blocked by unsupported artwork:
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.SVGGeometry: Native vector geometry could not be converted faithfully. No SVG was exported.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.SVGFont: A required font is not currently loaded. SVG export was stopped rather than substituting a font.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.SVGText: Native text styling or XML content is unsupported or invalid. No SVG was exported.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.Hint: Download artwork from the displayed Level using a dedicated render surface. Choose transparency or its Level background. No grid, tokens, walls, lighting, controls or Scene edits. Whole-map scope includes ordinary Unassigned artwork. A layer/group scope includes its descendants. Custom crop coordinates are Scene pixels; output size is crop size times scale.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.GMWarning: Choose an audience explicitly. Player export respects ancestor presentation gates and native hidden fields; unresolved membership is excluded. GM export respects your workspace gates and may disclose player-withheld or natively hidden content. Native-hidden geometry is half-opacity, with native text opacity unchanged. Orphan membership follows native GM visibility. Locked artwork remains included.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.Limits: Bounded publication: 1,000 Drawings, 100,000 coordinates, 4 MiB snapshot; one elevation/render mode; output up to 8,192px per axis and 16 million pixels, subject to GPU limits; scale 0.1-4. Background plus artwork textures share a 64-million decoded-pixel budget; backgrounds allow 8,192px axes and 16 MiB compressed files. Unsupported content/resources fail, never silently disappear. Strict vector SVG is available separately.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.BackgroundHint: Level background includes its base color and static background image, using native fit, anchor, offset, signed scale, rotation and tint. It excludes foreground/other-Level images, fog, lighting and padding. Content bounds include the transformed background; Scene rectangle clips to the map area. Background-only export is supported. External images need consent; videos, blocked images and artwork below the background elevation are refused.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.BackgroundInvali: The displayed Level background or transform is invalid or unsupported; no substitute background was exported.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.BackgroundOrder: Selected primary artwork is below the background elevation. This composition would change native stacking; choose transparent export or a different scope.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.GM: My GM workspace (may contain hidden content)
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.Whole: Whole drawing map on this Level
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.External: Allow external texture requests for this export
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.Changed: Artwork, layers, workspace, Level, authority or export window changed. Reopen export and review again.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.Options: Choose valid publication options and an explicit audience.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.Limit: Publication exceeds the output axis/pixel or GPU texture limit. Reduce scope or scale; no automatic resizing was performed.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.Encoding: WEBP encoding failed, exceeded 32 MiB or returned an unexpected MIME type/dimensions. No alternative format was downloaded.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.TextLimit: Publication text bitmap exceeds its 8,192px axis or 16-million-pixel limit. Reduce scope or scale.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Publication.PendingImport: Resolve unfinished or staged imports before publication.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Preview.Empty: No artwork is visible in the chosen export scope/audience.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.CatalogRemoveHint: Hide this saved file from the shared library for all GMs. Its JSON, textures and Scene artwork remain untouched. Refreshing or reloading will not bring it back; use Removed items to restore it. This is NOT file deletion.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.CatalogRestoreHint: Restore this current validated file to the shared library for all GMs. No JSON file or Scene artwork will be changed. Acceptance requires these reviewed bytes to remain unchanged.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.CatalogRemoved: Removed from the shared library. The JSON file is retained.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.CatalogChanged: This file's bytes or identity changed since removal. It stays removed. Review the current JSON before restoring; restoration accepts the current validated file, not the old version.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.CatalogMissing: Removed file is missing. Restore it externally at this path, then refresh before restoring its library entry.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.CatalogInvalid: Shared library catalog records are invalid. Repair the world setting before continuing.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.CatalogFull: The shared library holds at most 100 removed-item records across configured folders. Restore entries before removing more files.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.CatalogDenied: Shared library removal/restoration requires a GM with file-browse and world-setting permissions.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.CatalogWriteFailed: The shared library catalog update could not be verified.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.CatalogUnverified: Catalog update could not be verified; it may have persisted. Refresh and inspect Removed items before retrying. No JSON file was changed:
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.EditHint: Change the name, category and tags inside this portable JSON file. Artwork, layers, presets, texture references and embedded thumbnail stay unchanged. The filename and stable identity do not change. A separate replacement confirmation follows.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.DuplicateHint: Create a fresh portable JSON copy with a new identity/filename. Artwork, layers, presets and thumbnail are preserved; the source file stays unchanged. Choose a name, category and tags for the copy.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.ReplaceHint: This replaces the JSON file at the path below. Back it up first. Only name/category/tags change; existing artwork is not edited. Foundry uploads do not provide atomic compare-and-swap: do not edit this file concurrently in another browser or external tool. A persistent repair marker blocks uncertain files until explicitly reviewed.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.ManageDenied: Library metadata replacement requires a GM with file browse, upload and world-setting permissions. Duplication needs file browse/upload; repair needs file browse/world-setting permissions.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.OperationsInvalid: Library file-operation records are invalid. Repair the world setting before managing files.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.OperationsWriteFaile: The library file-operation record could not be verified. Refresh and inspect the file before continuing.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.EditUnverified: Metadata replacement could not be verified. A persistent repair marker may remain; the original or modified file may be present. Refresh and review it before retrying. No file was deleted:
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.RepairRequired: An unfinished metadata replacement requires review. This file cannot be imported, placed, edited or duplicated until resolved.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.RepairMissing: An unfinished metadata replacement points to a missing file. Restore or inspect this path using file administration, then refresh.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.RepairHint: The file has been re-read and validated. Accepting keeps these current bytes and clears the unfinished-operation marker; it does not restore old content or upload/delete anything. Review the actual JSON separately if needed. A changed fingerprint during this review will refuse acceptance.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.RepairMatchesAfter: Current bytes exactly match the intended replacement.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.RepairMatchesBefore: Current bytes exactly match the original file; the replacement did not persist.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.RepairDifferent: Current bytes differ from BOTH the original and intended replacement. Accept only after separately reviewing this changed file.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.RefreshAfterManage: The operation was verified, but library refresh failed. Do not repeat the operation; refresh or inspect the catalog/file:
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.SaveProjectHint: Save all Scene Drawings, nested layers, defaults and presentation presets as a fresh portable project JSON file. Includes native-hidden artwork and GM-only presentation content. This is not a Scene backup: tokens, walls, lights, backgrounds and other documents are excluded. The current JSON format supports one source Level, up to 10,000 Drawings, 1,000,000 points and 20 MiB. Unfinished imports and unsupported recovery data are refused. Texture files remain referenced, not copied.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.SaveThumbnailHint: The optional 256 x 192 WEBP thumbnail shows all saved artwork, including hidden content, not the player view. Rendering is bounded separately from JSON storage and can refuse large/mixed-render-mode projects or unavailable resources. A failed thumbnail requires explicit confirmation to save without it; it never changes the saved artwork.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.SaveThumbnailFailed: The thumbnail could not be generated. No file has been uploaded.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.IdentityInvalid: The new library project identity is invalid; nothing was uploaded.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.SaveHint: Save visible, unlocked selected Drawings as a new reusable shape JSON file. Geometry is normalized to grid squares (100 pixels on gridless Scenes); mixed render modes or footprints over 20 squares are refused. Up to 100 Drawings, 100,000 points and 4 MiB. Requires file browse/upload rights. Existing artwork and armed stamps are unchanged. Tags: up to 12 comma-separated values, 40 characters each.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.Field.name: Name
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.SaveDenied: Saving library files requires a GM with file browse and upload permissions.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.RefreshAfterSave: The file was saved and verified, but library refresh failed. Do not save another copy; refresh or inspect the file:
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.SaveBusy: A library save is already in progress.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.Collision: A file with this identity already exists; nothing was overwritten.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.SaveUnverified: Save could not be verified. A file may remain at this path; inspect it and refresh the library before retrying. No file was automatically deleted.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.WrongKind: This library file has the wrong package type; refresh the library before continuing.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.Configure: Configure an existing project library folder in Settings first.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.RefreshHint: Refresh to browse and validate the folder's project JSON files.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.ThumbnailScope: Embedded full-artwork preview, including hidden content.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.NoThumbnail: No embedded thumbnail. Review import to generate an artwork preview.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.ImageFailed: Embedded thumbnail could not be decoded. Artwork must still pass import validation.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.Denied: Library browsing requires a GM with Foundry file-browse permission.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.UnsafePath: Library file path is outside the configured folder or unsupported.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.ReadFailed: Library file or folder could not be read.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.TooLarge: Library read exceeds the 20 MiB per-file or 64 MiB per-refresh limit.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.TooMany: Library folder exceeds the 100 JSON-file limit. Use a smaller folder.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Library.Changed: Library file, configured folder or destination changed. Refresh and review again.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.ThumbnailExternalCon: Allow thumbnail generation to load external texture URLs. This contacts those hosts; external requests are refused unless enabled.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.ThumbnailDisclosure: The thumbnail shows all packaged artwork, including hidden content, but no Scene background. It is optional advisory metadata, not proof of valid artwork or available resources.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.ThumbnailFailed: Thumbnail generation failed. Export the validated artwork without a thumbnail, or cancel.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.PreviewScope: Full package artwork, including hidden content. Uses the selected resource replacements and import ordering; excludes destination artwork and Scene background.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.PreviewLoading: Generating artwork preview. This is optional; import validation and resource checks are independent.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.PreviewReady: Generated from validated artwork. Import is staged player-hidden regardless of this preview.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.PreviewUnavailable: Artwork preview unavailable. You may still import if validation and resource checks pass; the preview does not certify import readiness.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Toolbox.ScaleHint: Scales this toolbox and its Layers flyout together. Small sizes are for mouse input; use 100% tablet density for pen targets. Applied when the slider is released.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Toolbox.InvalidScale: Toolbox scale must be 50-125% in steps of 5%.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Settings.ToolboxScale.Name: Toolbox scale
FOUNDRYSHOP.Settings.ToolboxScale.Hint: Client-local whole-window scale, 50-125%. Includes text, chrome, controls and the Layers flyout, not unrelated dialogs. 50% suits mouse input; 100% tablet density preserves 44px pen targets.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Settings.ToolboxTheme.Name: Toolbox theme
FOUNDRYSHOP.Settings.ToolboxTheme.Hint: Foundryshop Slate is the Photoshop-inspired default. Foundry retains native styling. Game system opts into the active system's CSS theme where available. This is a per-client preference.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Preview.Scope: Full artwork on this Level, including hidden content
FOUNDRYSHOP.Preview.NoAccess: Layer previews require a GM and a valid Scene Level.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Preview.Limit: Preview exceeds its limits: 1,000 Drawings, 100,000 point coordinates, 250,000 estimated smoothing segments, 4 MiB of data or 16 textures.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Preview.MixedOrder: This preview renderer does not yet support mixed elevations or primary/interface artwork.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Preview.Geometry: Preview supports rectangles, ellipses and polygon/open-path Drawings with at least two points.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Preview.Style: Preview requires native Drawing styles, valid colors, opacity 0-1 and smoothing 0-1.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Preview.TextLimit: Preview text exceeds its limits: 8,192 characters, 8,192px wrap width or 8-256px font size.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Preview.Renderer: The native offscreen Drawing renderer is unavailable.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Preview.Texture: Preview texture is missing, invalid or too large.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Preview.TextureTimeout: Preview texture exceeded its five-second loading limit.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Preview.Font: Preview font is not loaded; no substitute font was rendered.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Preview.Encoding: Could not encode the preview as a WEBP within 256 KiB.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Preview.Options: Preview dimensions must be 32-512px with valid padding and an explicit external-resource acknowledgement.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Preview.Queue: Too many artwork previews are waiting. Refresh previews to retry.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Stamps.Hint: Copy up to 100 selected Drawings or load a PNG/JPEG/WEBP. Place uses a ghost and a primary canvas tap; Escape cancels. Over the canvas, Shift + wheel rotates 15 degrees; Ctrl + wheel scales by 10%. Alt combinations remain available to Foundry. Use the numeric rotation control for finer adjustments. The loaded stamp is session-only. Configure an existing image upload folder in Settings before importing or pasting images.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Stamps.NoCopy: Copy a shape or load an image first.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Stamps.NoAccess: Stamp placement requires a GM with Drawing creation permission, a ready Scene and active drawing mode.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Stamps.SelectionLimit: Choose 1 to 100 Drawings, at most 100,000 point coordinates and 4 MiB of shape data; placement may not exceed 10,000 Scene Drawings.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Stamps.HiddenLocked: Hidden or locked Drawings cannot be copied as a stamp in this build. Existing artwork was not changed.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Stamps.Unfinished: Resolve the unfinished project import before copying or placing stamps.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Stamps.MixedOrder: Stamp artwork and destination Drawings must share the same elevation and interface render group.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Stamps.Transform: Scale must be 0.05 to 20 and rotation -360 to 360 degrees, with finite placement coordinates.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Stamps.NativeChanged: Native Drawing validation would change this stamp's geometry or style. Reduce the scale or repair the source before placing it.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Stamps.Destination: Choose a visible, unlocked active Drawing layer and a displayed Level.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Stamps.Changed: The stamp destination changed. Review the Scene, Level and layer, then re-arm placement.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Stamps.Collision: A generated stamp ID collided; retry.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Stamps.SortSpace: There is no safe Drawing sort space for this stamp. Reconcile layer order before retrying.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Stamps.Renderer: The image stamp texture or native Drawing renderer is unavailable.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Stamps.Folder: Set an existing data folder for image uploads. Use a relative path without traversal or module/system directories.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Stamps.FolderHint: GM-only. An existing folder under Foundry's data source, such as worlds/my-world/artwork. Image assets persist if stamp placement is cancelled; create folders through Foundry's FilePicker.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Stamps.Upload: Image upload permission or file validation failed, or the uploaded asset path could not be verified. Images must be no larger than 16 MiB.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Stamps.Image: Use a valid PNG/JPEG/WEBP no larger than 4096 pixels per axis and 16 million pixels. This build rejects orientation-changing JPEGs.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Stamps.Animated: Animated images are not supported as stamps.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Stamps.Clipboard: No supported clipboard image is available, or clipboard access is unavailable. Use Import image or paste an image while drawing mode is active.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Stamps.AssetRetained: The uploaded image is saved in the configured folder. Cancelling placement does not delete the asset.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Palettes.DeleteConfirm: Delete this shared palette and its saved colors? Existing artwork and brush settings are unchanged.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Palettes.Name: Palette name
FOUNDRYSHOP.Palettes.Hint: Shared palettes are available to GMs. Tap a swatch to apply it to the active stroke/fill target; use Edit to change a saved color without changing your brush. Copying old colors preserves their original lists.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Palettes.Empty: Create a named palette or copy an existing color list to start.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Palettes.GMOnly: Only GMs can edit shared palettes in this build.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Palettes.Invalid: The shared palette collection is invalid.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Palettes.InvalidName: Palette names must contain 1 to 80 characters.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Palettes.DuplicateName: A shared palette already uses that name.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Palettes.Changed: Shared palettes changed while this action was open. Review them and retry.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Palettes.Full: Shared palettes support at most 32 palettes, 256 colors per palette and 2048 colors overall.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Palettes.Collision: A generated palette/color ID collided. No changes were saved; retry.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Palettes.WriteFailed: The shared palette write could not be verified. Reload and inspect the saved palettes before retrying.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Toolbox.PaletteDeleteConfirm: Remove this saved color? Existing artwork is unchanged.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Toolbox.LibraryPending: Project JSON exchange is available here. Thumbnail browsing and reusable shapes will be added in the library milestone.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Toolbox.Setting.drawingEdgeP: Allow edge auto-pan during new drawing creation
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.Title: Foundryshop Layers
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.DigestUnavailable: Import protection for existing artwork requires browser SHA-256 support. Open Foundry through HTTPS or localhost, then retry.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.EmptyMode: Empty Drawing project (no existing Drawings; confirm retained layer/preset replacement)
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.ReplaceEmptyMetadata: This Scene has no Drawings but retains {nodes} layers/groups and {presets} presets. Import will replace that metadata with the imported project in a player-hidden group. Tokens, Walls, backgrounds and other Scene content remain unchanged. Cancel to preserve the retained metadata, or choose additive mode instead. Proceed to preview?

Confirmed: retained layers/groups and presets will be replaced. The Scene must still contain no Drawings when import starts. Failed-import cleanup restores the prior metadata unless a conflicting change prevents safe cleanup.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.AdditiveMode: Add to existing project in a new hidden wrapper
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.AdditiveReview: Additive import: the new player-hidden wrapper is placed at the top of the layer stack, or above the chosen destination group's existing children. Existing Drawings, membership, sorts, locks, player gates, and presets remain unchanged. Imported presets capture existing player gates at import time, including destination ancestors; applying one restores those captured gates without implicitly opening hidden parents. Existing presets hide the new nodes when applied. Conflicting imported preset names receive numeric suffixes.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.FontMappings: Font replacements (JSON object: source family to available destination family)
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.CheckingResources: Checking project resources (up to 4 simultaneous requests, 5-second timeout per texture). No artwork is created until checks pass.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.ResourcesBlocked: Import is blocked by unresolved textures or fonts. Replace missing local textures/fonts and recheck. External URLs are not contacted during preflight and require explicit acknowledgement.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.AcknowledgeExternal: I accept unverified external texture URLs. Preflight will not contact them, but Foundry may load them when imported Drawings render, potentially sending requests to those hosts.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.ExternalAcknowledged: External texture URLs were explicitly accepted without verification. Rendering may contact their hosts; visual fidelity is not guaranteed.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.InvalidAssetMappings: Texture mappings must use inventoried source paths and nonempty trimmed destination paths.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.InvalidFontMappings: Font mappings must use inventoried source families and nonempty trimmed destination families.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.InvalidExternalAckno: External URL acknowledgement must be an explicit boolean.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.FontApiUnavailable: Foundry's loaded-font discovery API is unavailable. Resource preflight cannot continue.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.ResourceApiUnavailab: The browser URL or Foundry resource request API is unavailable. Resource preflight cannot continue.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.ResourceLimit: This project exceeds the limit of {count} distinct local texture checks. Split the project or reduce resource references before importing.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.ResourceRedirect: Redirect was not followed. Supply a direct local image path or explicitly acknowledge an external URL.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.ResourceNotImage: The server did not identify this resource as an image. Supply a directly accessible image path.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.ExportHint: Export the whole Drawing project, a layer/group subtree, or the selected Drawings, including artwork hidden from players and all included Drawing flags. This is not a player-view export or a Scene backup. Review module metadata before sharing the JSON. Author identities, GM workspace settings and unrelated Scene content are excluded.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.SelectionHint: To move a scrawled map, select its Drawings before opening Export. Selected Drawings only includes those strokes (including Unassigned artwork), their layer ancestry and scoped presets, not other artwork in those layers. Coordinates, styles and editable strokes are preserved; originals are never moved or deleted. In the prepared destination Scene, import this JSON with X/Y offsets. Additive import puts new artwork in a player-hidden wrapper. This is not layer transparency or stroke consolidation.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.SubtreeHint: Subtree export includes the chosen node and descendants, their artwork, and their ancestor chain (names, locks, defaults and presentation gates) without sibling artwork. Presets are restricted to included nodes; missing preset entries still mean hidden. Scene coordinates are preserved. Unassigned artwork is included in full-project export or when explicitly selected. The thumbnail covers only exported artwork.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.TargetGroupHint: Additive import may create its new player-hidden wrapper inside an unlocked group with unlocked ancestors, above its existing children. Existing Drawings, sorts, nodes and gates stay unchanged. Insufficient integer sort space or incompatible managed order refuses import; no automatic reordering. Imported presets preserve destination ancestor gates, so a hidden parent remains hidden.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.DiscardHint: Remove only this journaled import's Drawings and restore its prior layer project and retained path registry? This destructive cleanup verifies ownership and existing-artwork fingerprints, and refuses if other artwork, paths or tree changes have appeared. It never removes existing artwork or other Scene content.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.NoJournal: There is no interrupted import journal.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.RecoveryIntentPendin: A recovery ZIP import intent is retained. Ordinary Drawing-only discard cannot safely remove its file, Tile, background and recovery evidence. Keep the intent and reconcile it before retrying.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.DiscardSuccess: The interrupted import's own artwork and metadata were removed.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.ImportHint: Choose empty-project import or explicitly add to existing artwork. Empty-project mode refuses existing Drawings; retained layers/presets can be replaced only after separate confirmation. Additive imports create a new hidden wrapper at top level or inside a chosen unlocked group and preserve existing artwork/order. Coordinates are preserved unless translated; single-source-Level artwork maps to the displayed destination Level. Mixed managed elevation/render modes and invalid existing order are rejected.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.AssetMappings: Texture replacements (JSON object: source path to destination path)
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.ChooseFile: Choose a Foundryshop project JSON file.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.FileTooLarge: The project file exceeds the 20 MiB limit.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.Changed: The Scene or displayed Level changed during import. Start again.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.Summary: {drawings} Drawings, {nodes} layers/groups, {presets} saved presets. Destination Level: {level}. Translation: ({dx}, {dy}) pixels.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.Bounds: Conservative geometry bounds (text layout not measured)
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.PresentationHint: Artwork is placed in a player-hidden import group. Originally Unassigned artwork goes into Imported Unassigned. Apply the new Imported Presentation preset explicitly to present the saved gates. Native hidden/locked fields are preserved.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.ResourcesHint: Textures and fonts remain references, not embedded files. Import checks same-server textures with bounded HEAD requests and checks loaded Foundry font families. External URLs are never requested by preflight; explicit acknowledgement is required. Required metadata modules must already be active. Other modules' flags are opaque data; internal references are not automatically remapped. Availability is not a pixel-fidelity guarantee.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.ConfirmResources: Review resource checks and replacements before continuing. Local texture/font failures block import; checks run again immediately before writing. External URLs, if explicitly accepted, remain unverified. Multi-Level packages require the explicit source-Level or combine choice reviewed above. Recovery-bearing packages remain unsupported by this build.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Project.ImportSuccess: Drawing project imported player-hidden. Review it, then explicitly apply Imported Presentation when ready.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Settings.DrawingEdgePan.Name: Auto-pan at Screen Edges While Drawing
FOUNDRYSHOP.Settings.DrawingEdgePan.Hint: Allow Foundry to shift the map when creating a Drawing near a screen edge. Disabled by default to keep pen strokes steady. Normal canvas navigation and dragging existing objects are unchanged.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.InheritedLock: Locked by an ancestor. This button sets an additional local lock; unlock the ancestor to remove its protection.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.PresetHint: Presets save every layer/group's player gate, not your GM workspace. Applying a preset hides layers created after it was saved.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.NoPresets: Configure the Players column, then save a named presentation.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.PresetApplyPrompt: Replace the entire player presentation with this snapshot? Saved layers/groups use their recorded gates, including any permitted artwork; newer nodes are hidden. Your workspace, brush, selection, and active layer are unchanged.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.PresetRecapturePrompt: Overwrite this preset with every current player-presentation gate? This replaces the old snapshot and removes references to deleted nodes. The live presentation and your workspace are unchanged.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.PresetRemovePrompt: Delete only this presentation preset? No layers or artwork will be removed, and the live presentation is unchanged.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.InvalidPresetName: Enter a preset name containing 1 to 80 characters.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.InvalidPresets: Presentation presets contain invalid records. No changes were saved.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.DuplicatePresetName: A presentation preset already has that name. Choose a different name or explicitly replace the existing snapshot.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.NoPresetNodes: Add layers or groups before saving a presentation preset.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.PresetMissingNodes: This preset references {count} removed nodes. Review the live Players column and replace the snapshot, or delete the preset, before applying it.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.PresetMissingHint: {count} saved nodes are missing. Apply is disabled; review and replace the snapshot to repair it.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.PresetNewHint: {count} newer nodes will be hidden when this preset is applied.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.StateIncomplete: The layer or presentation change could not be fully verified. Refresh the panel, review the persisted state, and explicitly retry only if needed.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.DeletePresetHint: {count} presets reference nodes being removed. These snapshots will remain saved but cannot be applied until you review and replace them, or delete them.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.ShowPlayersAllPrompt: Allow every layer and subgroup in this group to be presented to players? This overwrites their individual settings, including layers you previously withheld. Ancestor gates outside the group are unchanged.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.MoveHint: Choose a parent group, or Top Level. The whole subtree moves; its IDs and Drawing membership stay unchanged. It inherits the destination's workspace and player visibility gates.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.DeleteHint: Remove this node and any descendants. Choose where their Drawings will move, or choose to delete the artwork too. Unassigned restores native visibility; another layer applies its visibility. Existing stroke styles are preserved.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.DeletePrompt: Remove this layer/group and its descendants, moving their Drawings to the chosen destination? No artwork will be deleted. The moved artwork may become visible to players.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.InvalidDestination: Choose an unlocked ordinary layer outside the removed subtree, or Unassigned.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.DeleteIncomplete: Removal did not fully complete. No artwork was deleted, but some membership or order changes may have been saved. Refresh the panel, inspect the destination, and repair order before retrying.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.DeleteArtworkPrompt: Remove this layer/group and permanently delete its {count} Drawings? Locked artwork blocks this action.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.DeleteArtworkIncomple: Removal with artwork did not fully complete. Some Drawings may already be deleted. Refresh the panel and review the layer before retrying.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.DuplicateGroup: Only ordinary layers can be duplicated.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.DuplicateIncomplete: Duplication did not fully complete. The new layer may contain only some copies. Review it, delete it if needed, and retry.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.TracingHint: Snapshots this layer into a faded, hidden, locked Tile under your drawings and hides the layer in your GM view so you can trace over it on another layer. Players never see it. Refresh after editing the source; adjust opacity in the Tile's settings.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.TracingDone: Tracing reference created. The source layer is hidden in your GM view; show it again with its eye or remove the reference.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.TracingEmpty: This layer has no drawings on the current level to trace.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.TracingGroup: Only ordinary layers can become tracing references.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.TracingUpload: The tracing image could not be uploaded. Check that you may upload files and that the stamp asset folder is valid.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.GroupHint: Group eyes preserve child settings. Show All / Hide All explicitly overwrite descendants. Click a group name to fold it; drag onto its middle to nest, or use Move to Group.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.Name: Layer name
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.Drag: Drag above/below to reorder or onto the middle of a group to nest; use arrows or Move to Group with a pen or keyboard
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.UnassignPrompt: Unassign the selected drawings? They will return to native visibility and may become visible to players.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.UnassignedHint: Unassigned drawings keep native visibility and sort. Unresolved layer references are hidden from players until assigned. Select drawings to manage them through layers.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.Empty: Add a layer to start organizing drawings. Existing artwork is not changed automatically.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.PresentationHint: GM view is private to your workspace. Players follows the GM presentation. Hidden artwork is not confidential storage.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.GMOnly: Only a GM can manage Foundryshop layers.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.NoScene: Open an active Scene before using Foundryshop layers.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.InvalidName: Enter a layer name containing 1 to 80 characters.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.InvalidState: The layer state is invalid or uses an unsupported version. No layer changes were saved.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.InvalidWorkspace: Your layer workspace settings are invalid. No workspace changes were saved.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.Changed: The Scene or layer state changed. Refresh the panel and try again.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.InvalidDrop: That layer move is invalid or would create a hierarchy cycle.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.MixedRenderOrder: Managed drawings must share an elevation and rendering mode for layer ordering. Foundryshop will not change those properties automatically.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.InvalidSort: Drawing sort values cannot be safely reconciled.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.OrderIncomplete: The layer change could not be fully verified. Refresh the panel and use Repair Drawing Order before continuing.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.DrawingUpdateIncomple: Not all Drawing changes were applied. Inspect membership and use Repair Drawing Order; no artwork was deleted.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.NoSelection: Select one or more existing drawings to move.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.Locked: The drawing or layer is locked, or you cannot edit it.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Layers.ActiveHidden: Your active layer is hidden in the GM workspace. Select it again to show it before drawing.
FOUNDRYSHOP.CanvasUnavailable: The game canvas must be ready to use the eyedropper.
FOUNDRYSHOP.InvalidWidth: Enter a whole-number stroke width of zero or greater.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Saved.Title: Saved Colors
FOUNDRYSHOP.Saved.PersonalHint: Private favorites for your user in this world, available across computers.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Saved.CampaignHint: Shared with this world. Only the GM can edit; everyone can use these colors.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Saved.ImportPrompt: Add your preset swatches to the chosen palette? Existing colors and browser presets will be preserved.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Saved.Name: Name (optional)
FOUNDRYSHOP.Saved.DuplicatePrompt: This color is already in this palette. Rename the existing entry instead?
FOUNDRYSHOP.Saved.Duplicate: That color already exists in this palette. Edit its existing entry instead.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Saved.Changed: This saved color changed or was removed while you were editing. Reopen the editor and try again.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Saved.GMOnly: Only a GM can edit campaign colors.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Saved.InvalidColor: Enter a six-digit hex color in #RRGGBB format.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Saved.InvalidName: Color names must be text with at most {max} characters.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Saved.InvalidPalette: The saved palette is invalid or uses an unsupported format. No changes were saved.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Saved.Full: A palette can contain at most {max} colors.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Toolbox.Title: Drawing Toolbox
FOUNDRYSHOP.Toolbox.WidthWheel: Line width — drag, pick a size, or scroll the mouse wheel here (Shift: ±5)
FOUNDRYSHOP.Toolbox.BrushPresetHint: Brush presets store line and fill color, width, opacity and pattern. Choose one to load it.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Toolbox.BrushPresetSave: Save current brush as a preset
FOUNDRYSHOP.BrushPresets.Name: Preset name
FOUNDRYSHOP.BrushPresets.Invalid: Brush presets could not be read. Saving and loading presets is disabled until they are repaired.
FOUNDRYSHOP.BrushPresets.Changed: That brush preset changed or was removed. Choose it again.
FOUNDRYSHOP.BrushPresets.Full: You can keep up to {max} brush presets. Delete one first.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Toolbox.NoColors: No saved colors. Create a palette to save some.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Toolbox.ModeHint.next: Next Shape: label the next drawing you create, then turn off
FOUNDRYSHOP.Toolbox.ModeHint.repeat: Repeat: label every drawing you create until turned off
FOUNDRYSHOP.Toolbox.ModeHint.place: Place Text: each tap on the canvas creates a text label (Escape to stop)
FOUNDRYSHOP.Toolbox.NoLabels: No labels yet. Use Manage labels to add some.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Toolbox.Rail.Label: Text & labels — open the Labels workspace and place the current label; click again to stop
FOUNDRYSHOP.Toolbox.Rail.Stamp: Stamp tool — place the copied stamp; click again to stop
FOUNDRYSHOP.Toolbox.Rail.StampEmpty: No stamp copied yet. Copy a selection, import an image or paste one to make a stamp.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Toolbox.SelectionApply: Apply chosen label to selected drawing
FOUNDRYSHOP.Toolbox.SelectOne: Select exactly one drawing to edit its label.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Toolbox.SelectionLocked: The selected drawing is locked or you cannot edit it.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Labels.InvalidStyle: Choose a valid font, whole-number size from 8-256 pixels, a six-digit text color and opacity from 0-1.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Labels.MissingFont: The label font {font} is not available in this world. Edit the saved label and choose an available font.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Labels.ExampleHint: Ready to place: Signika room labels, Amiri map names and Modesto Condensed headings. Examples carry their own font, size and color without changing brush defaults. Add Starter Labels copies them into your selected bank for editing.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Labels.DraftHint: Type directly in the preview, then Place label. Text/style edits cancel placement; font-size changes adjust the armed cursor label. Size is in canvas pixels; wrapping and canvas outlines may differ.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Labels.InvalidRotation: Enter a finite rotation from -360 to 360 degrees.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Labels.PlacementRejected: Label creation was refused. Check the active layer, permissions and locks before retrying.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Labels.PlacementHint: Click a saved label to arm its cursor preview, then click the canvas once to place. Escape cancels. Shift+wheel rotates 15 degrees; Ctrl+wheel changes font size 1px. Size and rotation controls also work without a wheel. Saved labels are not overwritten by placement adjustments.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Labels.SavedPreviewHint: Saved labels include starter defaults. Preview uses the saved font/color at 100% for 16-64px text; smaller/larger sizes use a readable representative scale, shown in the tooltip. Opacity is omitted here for readability; the editor and cursor use actual opacity.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Labels.SizeWheel: Scroll here to change text size (Shift: ±5). Size stays within 8-256 pixels.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Labels.Name: Button name (optional)
FOUNDRYSHOP.Labels.InvalidText: Label text must be 1 to {max} characters.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Labels.InvalidName: Label names must be text with at most {max} characters.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Labels.InvalidBank: The label bank is invalid or uses an unsupported format. No changes were saved.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Labels.Full: A label bank can contain at most {max} labels.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Labels.Changed: This label or drawing changed or was removed while you were editing. Try again.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Labels.GMOnly: Only a GM can edit campaign labels.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Labels.NoLayer: Open the Drawings controls on an active scene to use the drawing toolbox.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Labels.NoPermission: You do not have permission to create drawings.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Settings.ToolboxAutoShow.Hin: Open the floating drawing toolbox whenever the Drawings controls are active. It can always be opened from the Drawings toolbar.
FOUNDRYSHOP.Settings.ToolboxDensity.Name: Drawing Toolbox Size
FOUNDRYSHOP.Settings.ToolboxDensity.Hint: Button size for the drawing toolbox. Tablet uses large targets suited to pen input.
SETTINGS.HINT.shortcut_enabled: Open the Drawing Tools panel with a keyboard shortcut.
SETTINGS.HINT.color_selector_size: The size of the color selector canvas. Minimum 100.
SETTINGS.HINT.dropper_preview_size: The size of the dropper preview window. Minimum 20.
SETTINGS.HINT.dropper_read_radius: The radius of pixels displayed by the dropper preview pixel grid. A radius of 1 will only show the exact pixel hovered. A radius of 3 will show two extra pixels on each side surrounding the center pixel. Minimum 1
SETTINGS.HINT.preset_color_swatches: The color codes of the preset swatches under the color selector. These must be in '#XXXXXX' format and comma separated.
SETTINGS.HINT.recent_color_history: How many recently used colors to track for showing as color swatches.
